name: Create with Code - Prototype 4 - Only One Survivor!
author: Darkfall48
description:
A small arena game where you should be the greatest and the only one survivor by knocking your enemies out of the platform.

The enemies appear randomly and after the 4th wave, a boss appears.

Control:

- Use the right/left arrows to turn the camera
- Use the up/down arrows to move forward or backward.

Don't forget to turn on the volume
